verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows DeepSeek's official docs cover setup, pricing, rate limits, function calling, and feature announcements, but none of the claimed-docs items disclose model weaknesses, failure modes, or known limitations in DeepSeek's own documentation. Community threads discuss real-world failures (broken function calling, hallucinations, censorship) but that is third-party commentary, not vendor-authored transparency about jagged edges. Missing for 10: any vendor doc page listing known limitations, benchmark caveats, or failure-mode disclosures.
